references.text: Psalm 15:11 highlights that what comes out of the mouth reflects a person's heart, which aligns with Jesus' point in Mark 7:20 that what comes from within a person is what makes them unclean.

Isaiah 29:13 discusses how people honor God with their lips while their hearts are far from Him, corresponding to Jesus' message in Mark 7:20 that the inner condition of a person defines their purity.
Matthew 15:18-20 repeats and expands on Jesus' teaching that what comes out of the mouth originates from the heart, and this is what makes a person unclean, directly parallel to Mark 7:20.

Luke 6:45 speaks of how a good person brings forth good things from the good treasure in their heart, while an evil person brings forth evil, echoing the idea in Mark 7:20 that it is the inner life that defines a person's purity.
James 3:6 describes the tongue as a fire and a world of wickedness, which can be seen in light of Jesus' words in Mark 7:20 that what comes from within a person can make them unclean.
